entries.zh: 良能；不学而能的天赋能力
entries.en: innate ability; natural untaught capacity (Mencian liang-neng)
entries.notes: 西语词头 Dichamen delararayon 辨读失真不成词，释义依汉字良能与官话 liàng nèng（孟子语，谓天赋之能）拟定。
汉字栏标注[疑:齒/菌]，依西语 Dientes（牙齿）与官话 chy 定为齿。

entries.en: mouth and teeth; the teeth of the mouth

entries.zh: 蒜瓣；大蒜的鳞瓣（西语字面为蒜之齿）
entries.en: garlic cloves; clove of garlic (lit. 'teeth of garlic')
entries.notes: 汉字栏作蒜辮，但音写 pān（官话 bàn）与西语 dientes de ajo 均指向蒜瓣，字形疑辨读偏差。

entries.en: virtuous and wise; clever, capable, adept
xiao, a vertical bamboo flute; flute
entries.notes: 西语词头 Diestro encantar 与汉字簫不合，疑辨读失真；依汉字及音写 siaū 定为箫。

entries.en: ingenious, exquisite; skilful in one's craft
ten or so; a dozen or more

entries.zh: 万端；头绪纷繁、千头万绪

entries.en: all things, all creation; the myriad things

entries.zh: 兆；旧时大数名，此处注作万倍之数，亦极言众多
entries.en: chao, an ancient high numeral glossed 'ten thousand times'; a myriad-fold number

entries.zh: 亥；地支末位，当夜间九时至十一时
entries.en: hai, the 12th earthly branch; the double-hour 9-11 p.m.

entries.zh: 巳；地支第六位，当上午九至十一时
entries.en: si, the 6th earthly branch; the double-hour 9-11 a.m.
entries.notes: 闽南音写栏[残]（T99）且汉字标注[疑:巳/已]，依西语上午十时与官话 chīi 定为巳，释义存疑。
